players.product: Xiyun C500/C600 training-inference GPGPU boards and modules (plus Xisi N inference GPUs), GPU servers and supernode/cluster solutions with the MXMACA software stack

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results briefing: CTO and chief hardware architect Peng Li said the company has countermeasures and reliable domestic alternatives at the key supply-chain links - wafer foundry, packaging and large-capacity memory - so further geopolitical effects would have limited impact; C600 capacity is fairly secure and the C700 is proceeding to plan. CTO and chief software architect Yang Jian said MXMACA supports over 6,000 CUDA applications and natively adapts over 1,000 models.
